scope: Risk-focused review of declared source contracts and linked implementations; not an exhaustive security audit, independent review or runtime acceptance

groups.invariants: Shared public program owner proof (ACTIVE/mapped, matching published degree profile/version), geography predicates, canonical program-parent agreement on authoring and transaction-bound persistence, owner joins before stable page/count, public allowlist projections and published test references.
groups.remaining: Exact-SHA database/import/public-browser combinations and complete relationship acceptance remain release gates. Owner query limits or unavailable reads must remain explicit; a first page cannot establish a complete catalog.

groups.invariants: Separate edge cursors with owner/scope binding and bounded page sizes; unavailable collections retain unknown totals; published owner-localized labels and fallback provenance; slug-only public navigation; independent country-major/program owner queries; provider-HQ course relation explicitly distinguished from destination; visible refresh and request generation fencing.
groups.remaining: LIVE_OWNER_READS is not a global cross-owner snapshot or measured SLA. Full browser pagination and stale/withdrawal combinations are not accepted by source inspection.

groups.invariants: Score meaning belongs to the test owner and a published version: finite bounds, increments, variant/section membership, ambiguity rejection and immutable publication scale rows. Active requirements need public owner proof; unavailable scale semantics remain UNVERIFIED.
groups.remaining: Legacy unknown scales require owner review/republication rather than guessed rules. Full real author-review-publish browser journey and exact-SHA SQL parity remain mandatory before release.

groups.invariants: Immutable student cycle/owner snapshots, owner-controlled deadline, private history without alias transfer; transactional tracker/audit/timeline/outbox, CAS, bounded reconciliation and pre-delivery owner/student-role recheck; sorted locks and independent reviewer/revision checks for source/target transition; current identity/role authoritative replay with inbox idempotency; manual planning is not eligibility or application submission.
groups.remaining: Full provider and worker matrix, transaction failure combinations, complete catalog reconciliation cadence and hosting signal behavior remain limited by R08/R11/R12. Atomic mutation coordinator must remain wired by the application composition; optional test-adapter fallback is not production evidence.

groups.invariants: Owned saved rows and private owner adapters, unavailable-owner redaction and isolated errors; authenticated student document delivery with permission, consent, owner/cycle/version, fixed retention/expiry, byte size/digest and post-read rechecks; no exposed private storage grant, self-review or historical consent recreation.
groups.remaining: Real built API/provider delivery, ownership/consent revocation under storage IO and grant/retired-link proof remain release blockers R12-E02. Source review does not certify institutional academic truth.

groups.invariants: CMS reviewed/public root relationships are immutable without re-review, owner recheck before related public read and filter-before-limit; certificate historical signed affiliation separated from current trust/lifecycle; owner-opt-in discovery uses independent reviewer and current revisions; integrity is permissioned and bounded with explicit partial/unavailable results; integration registry has 26 distinct owners; explorer enforces owner permissions, public visibility and same-program relationship scope.
groups.remaining: Bounded integrity samples and owner-local counts are not full production integrity. Real provider trust, all graph consumers, full CMS Admin browser workflow and final market/locale acceptance remain outside this source review.

groups.invariants: Existing source contracts, database suites and browser/runtime evidence are separate proof layers. Source fixture discovery, mocked assertions and source build do not establish E2E, target identity, approval or exact-SHA runtime coverage.
groups.remaining: The complete disposable PostgreSQL/API/browser acceptance matrix remains deferred and is not silently waived. Final C2 evidence must satisfy the mandatory gates; full R13 remains BLOCKED.
